name: AI Dashboard
description: Provides a dashboard for AI modules and features.
consumes_plugin_types: dashboard Dashboard config entity — ships core.dashboard entity 'ai_dashboard' laid out with Layout Builder that renders at /admin/config/ai
Core Block (@Block) — defines 5 blocks (ai_setup_ai_provider, admin_menu_links, module_list_packages, ai_operations_status, ai_documentation) placed on the dashboard
project_browser ProjectBrowserSource (#[ProjectBrowserSource]) — provides the 'ai_dashboard_recommended' source (curated remote list of recommended AI recipes)
ai AiProvider (@AiProvider) — the Setup block and AiSetupStatus service read AI Core's provider plugins and config
config_action (setupAiProvider / simpleConfigUpdate) — the Setup form applies these to store a provider API key
project_description:
AI Dashboard provides a centralized, user-friendly interface for configuring and managing all AI-powered functionality in your Drupal site. This module replaces the existing AI configuration overview with a comprehensive dashboard that streamlines AI provider setup, feature installation, and system configuration.
 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Unified AI Provider Management: Configure multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, and more) from a single interface with easy API key management and provider selection. 
 Organized Feature Installation: Browse and install AI-powered capabilities organized by content type including Media, Content, Workflow, Assistants, Forms, and Multilingual support. Each category displays available AI features such as LLM Optimized Content, SEO Optimizer, Content Classification, and Image Classification. 
 Centralized Configuration: Access all AI-related settings through organized sections including AI Default Settings, AI API Explorer for testing, AI Agents management, and AI Assistants configuration. 
 Extensions Management: View and install AI Modules, AI Providers, and AI Tools through filterable, expandable sections that make it easy to extend your site's AI capabilities. 
 System Status Overview: Monitor configured providers and default models at a glance with collapsible status panels showing your current AI setup. 
 Integrated Documentation: Access detailed guides, reference materials, and tutorials for all AI features directly from the dashboard interface. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires the AI module and is designed to enhance its administrative interface. Individual AI features may have additional provider-specific requirements.

 
 
 Back to top 

 Supporting organization
